title: JUCE CMake Best Practices
description: Recommended patterns for JUCE CMake projects including modern C++ standards, output configuration, and dependency management
markdown:
# JUCE CMake Best Practices

## Modern C++ Standard

```cmake
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)  # Use -std=c++17, not -std=gnu++17
```

## FetchContent vs Add_Subdirectory

### FetchContent (Recommended)
```cmake
include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(
    JUCE
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE.git
    GIT_TAG 7.0.12
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(JUCE)
```

### Add_Subdirectory (For local JUCE)
```cmake
add_subdirectory(JUCE)  # JUCE folder in project root
```

## Essential JUCE Modules

```cmake
# Core (always needed)
juce::juce_core
juce::juce_data_structures
juce::juce_events

# Audio (most plugins need)
juce::juce_audio_basics
juce::juce_audio_processors
juce::juce_dsp

# GUI (editors need)
juce::juce_graphics
juce::juce_gui_basics
juce::juce_gui_extra
```

## Disable Unused Features

```cmake
target_compile_definitions(MyPlugin PRIVATE
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_ENABLE_LIVE_CONSTANT_EDITOR=0
)
```

## Build Type Configuration

```cmake
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()

# Optimization flags
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(MyPlugin PRIVATE
        $<$<CONFIG:Release>:/O2 /GL>
    )
else()
    target_compile_options(MyPlugin PRIVATE
        $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-O3 -march=native>
    )
endif()
```

## VST3 Copy to Plugin Folder

```cmake
# Auto-copy to system plugin folder after build
if(APPLE)
    set(PLUGIN_DIR ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3)
elseif(WIN32)
    set(PLUGIN_DIR $ENV{LOCALAPPDATA}/Programs/Common/VST3)
else()
    set(PLUGIN_DIR ~/.vst3)
endif()

add_custom_command(TARGET MyPlugin_VST3 POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
        $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:MyPlugin_VST3>
        ${PLUGIN_DIR}/MyPlugin.vst3
)
```

implementation_examples.title: Production-Ready CMakeLists.txt
implementation_examples.code:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(MySynth VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

# Modern C++
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# Build type
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()

# JUCE
include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(JUCE
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE.git
    GIT_TAG 7.0.12
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(JUCE)

# Plugin
juce_add_plugin(MySynth
    PLUGIN_NAME "MySynth"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER "SynthCo"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE "SntC"
    PLUGIN_CODE "MSyn"
    FORMATS VST3 AU Standalone
)

target_link_libraries(MySynth PRIVATE
    juce::juce_audio_utils
    juce::juce_audio_processors
    juce::juce_dsp
    juce::juce_gui_basics
)

target_compile_definitions(MySynth PRIVATE
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
)
